title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero/Tomb Raider #2
desc: YO...LARA CROFT! The can’t-miss crossover event of the year continues as Lara Croft, Shipwreck, and an elite G.I. Joe battalion descend on Cobra Island by land, sea, and air! Can they win a race against time to solve a deadly puzzle before Destro and his Iron Grenadiers unlock its secret?
